objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-msc-eviltwin-directory-path-manipulation
objects.description: The following analytic detects potential MSC EvilTwin loader exploitation, which manipulates directory paths with spaces to bypass security controls. The technique, described as CVE-2025-26633, involves crafting malicious MSC files that leverage MUIPath parameter manipulation. This detection focuses on suspicious MSC file execution patterns with unconventional command-line parameters, particularly those containing unusual spaces in Windows System32 paths or suspicious additional parameters after
